notes: The datasheet's table is an image: values read by OCR, check them against the PDF. Size 6.5" from the frame size in the model name (the datasheet doesn't state it). Xmax 7 mm is half the published linear coil travel (14 mm peak to peak). Published Bl 8 T·m disagrees with Fs, Mms, Re and Qes, so it's left out (the app derives it). Coaxial: the woofer's parameters (the tweeter's are left out).
